about: The documents attribute_effects renders, one for each attribute of the schema and, for an enumeration or a boolean, one for each value, for scripts/check-codegen-sdk.mjs: each SDK's CI writes the code that the code generator gives for a document, renders it and the XML, and requires the same PDF. Generated by `make gen-codegen-corpus` from src/core/src/attribute_effects.rs; cargo test fails when it differs. Left out are the data-binding attributes, which the code generator cannot write and data.rs tests; what attribute_effects excuses and a value the engine refuses in any document, listed under excused with the reason.
